title: Shared definitions for chorus records
description: Building blocks referenced by the rsvp, finding-report, vote-report, review-record and sdlc-log schemas. Not a record kind of its own.

schema_version.description: The schema version the record was written against: a major, optionally a .minor. The validator supports one major (1) and reports any other as a version mismatch.

secret_filter.description: Whether the secret pre-filter (CONDUCTOR.md § Secret pre-filter) ran over this run's memory writes. Not run is recorded as such, never as zero drops.

ran.description: true when every candidate memory write passed the filter; false when it did not run.

drops.description: Candidate facts the filter dropped. Required when ran is true; absent when it is false.

note.description: Why it did not run, or where the drops are audited.

timestamp.description: A moment with its time zone: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optional seconds, then Z or an offset. Same shape as problem-brief timestamps.

severity.description: The three-level scale owned by GATE-PRIMITIVE.md, shared by findings and decisions.

final_severity.description: Post-tally severity. 'dropped' is the demotion of a 🟢 (GATE-PRIMITIVE.md Stage 4: 🟢→drop).

confidence.description: Declared confidence_on_hand: epistemic sufficiency of the evidence on hand. low requires need_info (S11). Declared by the persona, never inferred.

persona.description: The persona's agent name as installed, e.g. eric-evans-advisor.

lens.description: The lens the persona reviews through, e.g. DDD, architecture, security.

finding_id.description: Fn for a Round-1 or gate finding; R2-n for a finding derived in Round 2.

locator.description: The finding's target: '<file>:<line>', '<file>:<start>-<end>', or a principle tag such as '[principle] constitution §III'.

pull_quote.description: One short sentence in the persona's own words, marked by the persona. Relayed verbatim, never selected or paraphrased by the conductor (I6).

evidence.description: One piece of I8 evidence behind a finding or vote.

kind.description: file_line: a real anchor in the corpus. principle: an existing principle, ref says where it is established. principle_proposed: a principle named here for the first time.

ref.description: file_line: '<file>:<line>' or '<file>:<start>-<end>'. principle: where it is established (constitution clause, prior finding, project doc). principle_proposed: the principle's name.

note.description: What this citation shows, in one sentence.

need_info_reason.description: One raiser's reason for an open NEED_INFO flag. A finding may carry several.

raiser.description: The persona that raised the flag.

reason.description: One sentence naming what is missing.

stage.description: Where the flag was raised: Stage 2 (author) or Stage 3 (vote).

id.description: Finding id, unique within its record.

locator.description: The target the finding is about; duplicates are grouped only on an identical locator.

claim.description: The finding itself, in the persona's words. Counts toward the report's word limit.

evidence.description: I8 evidence. Empty means the finding is demoted to [unsupported] at registration and excluded from vote, tally and ranking.

proposed_severity.description: The author's severity, before the vote.

pull_quote.description: The persona-marked PULL-QUOTE for this finding.

confidence_on_hand.description: Declared per finding. low → need_info must be true.

need_info.description: Open NEED_INFO flag (S11). true blocks the tally for this finding.

need_info_reason.description: One sentence naming what is missing. Required when need_info is true.

conditional_on.description: The stated assumption this finding depends on while one of the persona's gates is unmet (S10).

scope.description: Gate A premise pass only: the author's declared scope, confirmed by the vote.

attack_form.description: Premise findings only: which of the four premise attack forms this finding carries (chorus-sdlc § Gate A · 1).

experiment.description: The cheapest experiment that would settle it. Required with attack_form unvalidated-assumption.

derived_from.description: Round-2 derived findings only: the finding whose implications led here.

graded.description: false for R2- derived findings: no second lens has voted on them.

ruling_ref.description: A pointer to an operator ruling held elsewhere. Chorus records never restate a ruling; they cite it (Q-2).

id.description: The id exactly as the record that holds it writes it: R-n for a ruling, Q-n for a brief entry. One spelling only; record says which brief, so no subject prefix.

record.description: Where the ruling lives: a path to a brief's JSON (from the repository root), a URL, or '#' for this record's own local_rulings (fallback when no ruling sink is bound). The validator opens a local path and checks the id is there.

rsvp_row.description: One roster member's RSVP outcome as recorded in a review record or ledger.

decision.description: The persona's own reply (I2). EXCEPTIONAL is exceptional entry beyond the cap.

uncovered_delta.description: EXCEPTIONAL only: the delta no seated ordinary lens covers.

reason.description: One-line reason, or the failure-rule reason (not installed, silent, past budget, malformed, over-length, no evidence).

failure.description: Set when the persona counts as ABSTAIN under the one failure rule, after its one automatic retry also failed (not-installed has no retry).

seated.description: Whether the persona holds a seat on this board.

register_entry.description: One row of the findings register — the single human-facing source of truth, written before the vote.

id.description: Fn, or R2-n for a derived finding.

evidence.description: The finding's I8 evidence, copied from the report.

unsupported.description: true: no file:line and no principle tag — visible, but outside the matrix, the vote and convergence (I8).

need_info.description: Open NEED_INFO flag. true shows the row held.

need_info_reasons.description: One entry per raiser. Required when need_info is true.

derived_from.description: R2- only: the finding it was derived from.

scope.description: Gate A only: premise or within-frame, as confirmed by the vote.

parked.description: Gate A only: a within-frame finding parked from the premise pass.

convergence_notes.description: Converging lenses, each in its own Round-2 words.

tally_row.description: One row of the consolidation matrix: the deterministic Stage-4 count for one finding. A projection; it re-authors nothing.

finding.description: The register entry this row counts.

status.description: graded: counted. held: NEED_INFO open, not counted (not movement unmoved, which is counted). ungraded: R2- derived. unvoted: every voter abstained. minority-report: exactly one non-author voter; not counted, keeps its authored severity, never gating, listed apart and out of the top five.

n.description: N: the count of non-author voters on the finding (GATE-PRIMITIVE.md Stage 4). A tally must not run at N < 2.

net.description: net = P − O. CONFIRM is excluded.

movement.description: escalate: net ≥ T, severity up one level. demote: net ≤ −T. agreed: unmoved, with CONFIRM votes. unmoved: counted, |net| < T, no CONFIRM; the authored severity stands. unvoted: all abstained.

final_severity.description: Post-tally severity: authored severity moved at most one level.

convergence.description: Convergence = P + C, used to rank, never to escalate.

extract_record.description: A Stage-1 extract record: one factual observation, no judgment.

candidate_lens.description: The lens this most concerns, or 'unassigned'.

bindings.description: Which provider served each port, and every failure the round recovered from without asking the operator (chorus-review § One failure rule). Shown once at the top of the page.

ports.description: One row per port the round used.

port.description: The port, as CONDUCTOR.md § Ports names it.

provider.description: What served it, e.g. problem-brief or coryphaeus, or 'default' when the port fell back to its recorded default.

recoveries.description: Recovered failures, never asked live. Empty when nothing failed.

kind.description: retry: a failed persona reply sent back once. fallback: a missing optional tool replaced by its port's default. abstention: a persona counted ABSTAIN because its retry also failed.

subject.description: The persona (retry, abstention) or the port (fallback).

phase.description: Where it happened, e.g. rsvp, round-1, round-2.

reason.description: What failed, in one line, e.g. the validator's reason.

side_note.description: A conductor side-note: flag-only, routed to the operator, never changes severity or the tally (CONDUCTOR.md § Side-notes).

regime.description: The declared risk regime the procedure entered.
